scope: All controlled project sessions/root agents and shared heavy executor; not an assertion that unrelated user apps or all app-account chats are inactive.
source: Actual direct wait_threads timeout0 and collaboration.list_agents; root stops other work at admission. All project heavy work is additionally serialized by the original lease.
uncontrolled_host_activity: Live UnrealEditor/zenserver/Code activity is recorded; no permission inferred to pause them. No whole-machine quiet or physical-core isolation claim.
root_during_timing: Only bounded status waits and concise user progress; no source edits/scans/compilers/native/agent work.
